applicableAreas: Southern property perimeter trees near OHE line
Western property perimeter trees near OHE line
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows trees planted 5-10 feet from overhead electric distribution lines along southern and western property boundaries, but does not identify species of individual trees. Plant schedule lists species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) with total quantities but does not indicate which species are planted at which locations. Cannot verify whether non-utility-compatible trees (Cedar Elm and Live Oak are non-UC species) are within 15-foot restricted zone without species identification on plan drawing.

applicableAreas: Southern property perimeter trees near OHE line
Western property perimeter trees near OHE line
findings.comment: Large trees (Cedar Elm and Live Oak, with mature heights 40+ feet) are proposed within 5-10 feet of overhead distribution lines, inside the 25-foot clearance zone. However, plant schedule does not provide mature height specifications—only container-grown minimums (16' HT minimum). Large trees are not differentiated on landscape plan to allow verification of 25-foot clearances from distribution conductors. Without mature height data and species identification on the landscape plan, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Trees near western property boundary overhead electric line
Trees near southern property boundary overhead electric line
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines on western and southern property boundaries are supported by poles; landscape plan shows trees 5-10 feet from these conductor lines. Without dimension callouts showing distances from proposed trees to specific pole locations and without pole positions clearly marked on the landscape plan, cannot verify that all trees maintain minimum 10-foot clearance from pole centerlines.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad areas west of Buildings 1, 2, 8
Transformer pad areas east of Buildings 4, 7
Pull box near southern property boundary
findings.comment: Electrical transformer pads and pull boxes are located near the western and southern property boundaries where trees are proposed. Electrical plan shows transformer pad west of Building 1, 2, and 8, and pull box near southern boundary. Landscape plan shows trees in these areas but provides no dimension callouts verifying that proposed trees maintain minimum 10-foot clearance from pad-mounted equipment access doors.

applicableAreas: Areas where proposed trees are within 20 feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: Underground electric lines are shown routing through landscaped areas and past pull box locations. Landscape plan details (Sheet 37) show standard tree planting specifications but contain no root barrier details. Cannot verify whether root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) are specified for trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment.

findings.comment: Landscape plan uses functional classification symbols (M for mitigation tree, SY for street yard tree, ST for street yard tree, P for parking buffer point, PL for parking lot tree) but does not identify species for any proposed trees shown on the drawing. Plant schedule (Sheet 35) lists species and quantities separately but does not show where each species is planted on the landscape plan. Reviewer cannot cross-reference specific tree symbols on the landscape plan to species identification.

applicableAreas: Proposed Cedar Elm trees (40-50 ft mature height)
Proposed Live Oak trees (40-80 ft mature height)
All areas with large trees near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Large trees (Cedar Elm at 40-50 ft mature height, Live Oak at 40-80 ft mature height per ECM Appendix F) are not differentiated on the landscape plan. Plant schedule shows only container-grown minimum heights (16' HT minimum) rather than mature heights, and does not indicate which trees are large (40+ feet). Large trees require enhanced clearances (25 feet from distribution, 50 feet from transmission) and must be clearly identified on plans to allow clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Trees near overhead electric distribution lines
findings.comment: No dimension callouts or measurement annotations are provided on the landscape plan to show clearance distances between proposed trees and the overhead electric conductors. Cannot verify whether any clearance measurements are taken from the outside edge of conductors (as required) rather than from pole centerline.

applicableAreas: Trees near overhead electric distribution lines
findings.comment: Trees on landscape plan are shown as circular canopy symbols with trunk center points. No dimension callouts terminate at tree trunk centers to show clearance measurements. Cannot verify whether clearance distances are measured from tree trunk locations (as required) rather than from the edge of projected canopies.

applicableAreas: Trees within 15 feet of overhead distribution conductors
Large trees within 25 feet of overhead distribution conductors
All areas with proposed trees near electric facilities
findings.comment: Proposed trees are located within the restricted clearance zones adjacent to overhead electric distribution lines (5-10 feet from the OHE line). No written approval from Austin Energy is provided or referenced in the site plan documents to authorize tree placement within these prohibited zones. Variations to planting distances and species near utility facilities require explicit written approval from Austin Energy.
